threat_event: Phished gateway console password used to insert a skimming script into the hosted payment page custom header of e-commerce merchants
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: MFA optional on the console and used by 2 of 6 accounts; custom header field accepts script; no record of page content; no console alerting
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-01; about 120 e-commerce merchants' hosted payment pages; BP-03
likelihood_basis: EV-003 (MFA on 2 of 6 console accounts); EV-004 (custom header accepts script; no console alerts); EV-036 (annual video only; no phishing exercises)
regulatory_driver: PCI DSS 8.4.2; PCI DSS 6.4.3; PCI DSS 11.6.1; 16 CFR 314.4(c)(5)
existing_controls: Suite anti-phishing filter; processor partner's own platform protections
treatment_plan: MFA required on every console account (processor partner setting); payment page script inventory with approval and monthly comparison; weekly console log review; phishing simulations

threat_event: Console account takeover used to log in as merchants and push refunds to attacker-controlled prepaid cards
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Every staff console role can impersonate any merchant and issue refunds; no MFA on 4 of 6 accounts; no refund alerts
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-01; merchants' virtual terminals; BP-02; BP-03
likelihood_basis: EV-003 (4 staff accounts hold the support role that can log in as merchants and refund); EV-004 (no refund alerts set up)
existing_controls: Processor partner refund limits per merchant
treatment_plan: MFA on all console accounts; remove impersonation rights from everyone except the two support staff; ask the processor partner for refund alerts to the Operations Manager

threat_event: Card data handled in the keyed-entry service is exposed: spoken card numbers and security codes kept in call recordings, and card details typed on general-purpose laptops on a flat network
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Call recordings held card data and security codes for 14 months; shared phone admin login; support laptops share the staff network and are used at home
likelihood_basis: EV-056 (card data in about 2,050 recordings, 2026-07-21); EV-013 (shared phone administrator login); EV-020 (flat staff network); EV-043 (keyed entry at home)
regulatory_driver: PCI DSS 3.3.1; PCI DSS 3.2.1; PCI DSS 1.3.1; 16 CFR 314.4(c)(3)
existing_controls: Laptop encryption; recordings encrypted at rest by the phone vendor
treatment_plan: Recordings with card data deleted 2026-08-14; stop the keyed-entry service on 2026-10-15 and move merchants to the gateway mobile app; until then, recording off for the support queue and keyed entry only on the two support laptops in the office

threat_event: Mailbox compromise exposes merchant owner Social Security numbers and bank details in emailed applications
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Agents email applications as plain attachments; years of applications in mailboxes and the shared drive; push MFA without number matching
likelihood_basis: EV-012 (agent applications as plain attachments; mailboxes back to 2023); EV-011 (push MFA without number matching)
existing_controls: MFA on email; suite anti-phishing filter
treatment_plan: CRM secure upload link for all applications; block inbound attachments with Social Security numbers using the suite's data loss prevention rule; purge application attachments from mailboxes after CRM import; number matching for MFA

threat_event: Website application bucket exposed through the outdated form plugin or the full-rights access key
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Plugin two major versions behind; full-rights key in a configuration file; 610 files never deleted; no bucket access logging; only the web developer can administer it
likelihood_basis: EV-023 (plugin two major versions behind; 610 files; logging off; developer-only login); EV-055 (full-rights key in the configuration file)
existing_controls: Bucket public access blocked; provider encryption at rest
treatment_plan: Replace the website form with the CRM's secure upload link; export and then delete bucket contents; rotate and narrow the key; turn on access logging; transfer the hosting login to the company

threat_event: Former employee or outside agent uses access that was never removed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No offboarding checklist; agent contract endings not linked to access removal; a former agent's console and CRM accounts were active 5 months after exit (disabled 2026-07-15)
likelihood_basis: EV-049 (former agent accounts active 5 months); EV-043 (no offboarding checklist or review)
existing_controls: CRM limits agents to their own merchants
treatment_plan: Offboarding checklist for employees and agents; monthly reconciliation of console, CRM, portal, and phone users against the roster; six-month access review

threat_event: Caller posing as a merchant persuades support to change the merchant's deposit bank account, diverting settlement funds
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No call-back rule; staff not trained on this pretext; a March 2026 attempt was stopped only by the processor partner
likelihood_basis: EV-008 (March 2026 request stopped by the processor partner); EV-043 (no call-back rule); EV-036 (no pretext training)
existing_controls: Processor partner asks for a signed change form
treatment_plan: Call-back rule: any deposit account or owner contact change is confirmed by calling the number on file in the CRM, never the caller's number; two-person approval in the portal; training and a quarterly drill

threat_event: A compromise is handled late or wrongly: the 24-hour contract notice, Visa's 3-calendar-day clock, and state notices are missed
threat_source: Gaps in the company's own process
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No written incident response plan; processor partner and sponsor bank incident contacts not recorded; no tabletop
likelihood_basis: EV-035 (no incident response plan or incident contacts); EV-025 (24-hour contract notice)
existing_controls: Cyber insurance with a breach hotline
treatment_plan: P08 runbook and notification matrix approved 2026-08-31; contacts recorded and confirmed each quarter; tabletop with the MSP by 2026-11-30

threat_event: PCI DSS validation fails or is found to be inaccurate, putting the ISO agreement at risk
threat_source: Gaps in the company's own process
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 2025 SAQ left out the keyed-entry path; no scope confirmation; many requirements not in place; one person prepares and the Owner signs without review
likelihood_basis: EV-033 (2025 SAQ scope named the console only); EV-035 (no scope confirmation or targeted risk analyses)
regulatory_driver: PCI DSS 12.4.1; PCI DSS 12.5.2; PCI DSS 12.5.2.1
existing_controls: Annual SAQ and AOC; passing ASV scans; disclosure to the processor partner on 2026-08-20
treatment_plan: Accurate 2026 SAQ with the scope in P02, an action plan for anything not in place, and the Owner's review meeting before signing; six-month scope confirmation; shrink scope by stopping keyed entry

threat_event: Ransomware delivered by phishing encrypts laptops and synced suite files
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Antivirus only, no EDR; no phishing exercises; suite backup never restore-tested
likelihood_basis: EV-018 (no EDR in MSP services); EV-036 (no phishing exercises); EV-021 (no restore jobs)
existing_controls: MSP antivirus and patching; daily suite backup with 1-year retention
treatment_plan: First restore test by 2026-10-31 and quarterly after; MSP-managed EDR on all laptops; phishing simulations

threat_event: MSP remote management tool compromised and used to reach every laptop, including keyed-entry laptops
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No evidence of MFA on the MSP tool or of which technicians have access; no security terms in the MSP contract
likelihood_basis: EV-027 (no security terms; tool reaches every laptop); EV-048 (no evidence of MFA or technician list supplied)
existing_controls: MSP is an established firm with a written contract
treatment_plan: MSP contract amendment: MFA on the tool, named technicians, 24-hour incident notice, annual evidence; responsibility matrix

threat_event: Tampered or swapped payment terminal sent to a merchant skims cards at the counter
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Returned terminals are not inspected; inventory not reconciled since 2025; staff not trained on tamper signs
likelihood_basis: EV-024 (spreadsheet last reconciled in 2025; no inspection field); EV-043 (returned terminals not inspected)
existing_controls: Spare terminals locked in a cabinet; terminals arrive key-injected from the processor partner
treatment_plan: Monthly inventory reconciliation by serial number; inspection checklist for returned units; return damaged units to the processor partner instead of redeploying

threat_event: Fraud filter thresholds set by the company decline legitimate consumer purchases or let fraud through for e-commerce merchants
threat_source: Configuration error; model drift in the vendor's fraud-scoring model
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Defaults set in 2024 never reviewed; no monitoring of decline rates; vendor model updates not announced to the company
likelihood_basis: EV-006 (2024 defaults unchanged; 104 of 120 merchants on defaults)
regulatory_driver: FTC Act Section 5, 15 U.S.C. 45 (unfair practices); P10
existing_controls: Merchants can review held transactions
treatment_plan: P10 conditions: review thresholds with each merchant; monthly decline-rate report from the gateway; change log for filter settings

threat_event: Staff paste merchant statements and merchant data into public generative AI chatbots
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No rule against it before 2026-09-01; no approved tool
likelihood_basis: EV-045 (staff AI survey); EV-031 (no AI tool purchased)
existing_controls: None
treatment_plan: POL-02 C.2 and POL-04 4.6 prohibit it; approved business AI assistant with no-training terms; training

threat_event: Outbound support calls recorded without announcement, breaching Florida's all-party consent rule
threat_source: Gaps in the company's own process
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Inbound calls play an announcement; outbound calls do not
likelihood_basis: EV-013 (announcement on inbound calls only)
existing_controls: Inbound announcement
treatment_plan: Recording off for outbound calls until the phone vendor's outbound announcement is configured

threat_event: Hurricane or internet outage closes the office for several days
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single office and single internet line
likelihood_basis: EV-020 (one internet line); EV-047 (home working described by process owners)
existing_controls: Laptops, SaaS, and the phone app work from home
treatment_plan: Accepted by the Owner: home working covers the office. Recorded in the short contingency plan (CP-2) due 2026-11-30

threat_event: Outside sales agents mishandle merchant applications (personal email, paper left in cars, unencrypted phones)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No security terms in agent agreements; no agent training; agents not background-checked
likelihood_basis: EV-002 (agent agreements without security terms, training or screening); EV-012 (agents email applications)
existing_controls: CRM with MFA for agents
treatment_plan: Agent agreement addendum with security terms; CRM upload link only; annual agent training; background checks at renewal

threat_event: Processor partner outage or breach stops merchants and the company's tools
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No availability commitment or incident notice to the company in the ISO agreement
likelihood_basis: EV-025 (no availability commitment or incident notice to the company)
existing_controls: Processor partner AOC on file
treatment_plan: Ask for an availability commitment and incident notice to the company at renewal; keep merchant fallback instructions current

threat_event: Operations Manager is unavailable and nobody else can run administrator tasks or respond to an incident
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One person holds most administrator knowledge and duties
likelihood_basis: EV-048 (Operations Manager holds most administrator knowledge); EV-043 (intake interviews)
existing_controls: Owner holds some administrator rights
treatment_plan: Administrator runbook; the Merchant Support Lead becomes backup administrator for the console, phone, and CRM

threat_event: Web developer is unavailable or compromised, leaving the website and bucket without an administrator
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: The developer holds the only hosting login; no contract security terms
likelihood_basis: EV-023 (developer holds the only hosting login); EV-028 (2023 engagement letter without security terms)
existing_controls: None
treatment_plan: Transfer the hosting account to the company with MFA; developer gets a named, revocable account

threat_event: Lost or stolen laptop
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Laptops travel home daily
likelihood_basis: EV-017 (full-disk encryption on all 9 laptops; remote wipe); EV-043 (laptops used at home)
existing_controls: Full-disk encryption; no local data by design; MSP can wipe remotely
treatment_plan: Accepted by the Owner: laptops are encrypted and hold no local data

threat_event: Unapproved third-party scripts on merchants' hosted payment pages are altered by their owners or an attacker to skim cards
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: P07 found analytics scripts on 2 merchants' pages added in 2025 with no approval, inventory, or integrity check
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-01; 2 e-commerce merchants' hosted payment pages
likelihood_basis: EV-CM-8 (P07 page content export, 2026-08-04)
existing_controls: Processor partner's platform protections
treatment_plan: Remove both scripts (merchants agreed; done 2026-08-12); inventory and approval rule (POL-04 4.9); monthly comparison
